Name: Genubath, Son of Hadad
Summary: Genubath was the son of Hadad the Edomite by Pharaoh's sister-in-law, weaned by Queen Tahpenes and raised in Pharaoh's household among Pharaoh's sons.
RelatedPeople: Hadad, Prince of Edom; Tahpenes, Queen of Egypt
LifeLesson: A child raised between two kingdoms belongs fully to neither.
